global_changes.explanation: All 89 task top-level git tree SHAs differ between TB2 (69671fb) and TB2.1 (7131e43) because two global commits on terminal-bench-2 prior to the TB2.1 snapshot touched every task: (1) commit 8773c98 added an identical .gitignore (blob ecd089e8ac7767b9bdb6f3ac247c8d033f7565ab) and a generated README.md to all 89 tasks; (2) commit 2fd12b8 rewrote all 89 task.toml manifests from version='1.0' to schema_version='1.1' (adding [task] header/description/keywords/authors, converting memory/storage strings to memory_mb/storage_mb integers, and adding default gpus=0, allow_internet=true, mcp_servers=[], and empty [verifier.env]/[environment.env]/[solution.env] tables). For 73/89 tasks, normalized semantic task.toml fields are completely unchanged.

discrepancy_resolution.explanation: Between TB2 pin 69671fb and TB2.1 main 7131e43: (1) Commit 53ff2b8 ('Various task fixes for TB2.1') landed directly on terminal-bench-2 main before the repo split, modifying 7 tasks (crack-7z-hash, filter-js-from-html, gpt2-codegolf, install-windows-3.11, overfull-hbox, query-optimize, rstan-to-pystan). (2) PR #53 ('Update tasks for Terminal-Bench 2.1') and the TB2.1 README list 26 tasks, which include 5 of the 7 tasks from 53ff2b8 but omit crack-7z-hash and gpt2-codegolf because their task.toml timeout/memory bumps had already landed on terminal-bench-2 main in 53ff2b8. (3) The TB2.1 release announcement ('fixes 28 tasks') counts the 26 PR #53 tasks plus crack-7z-hash and gpt2-codegolf (26 + 2 = 28). (4) When terminal-bench-2-1 (initial snapshot 320a8be, unchanged under tasks/ through 7131e43) was created after terminal-bench-2 HEAD 2fd12b8, 28 task trees differed from 2fd12b8: the 26 PR #53 tasks plus two housekeeping changes not listed in PR #53 or the announcement — pytorch-model-recovery (CPU-only torch wheel + apt list cleanup + image tag bump) and sanitize-git-repo (splitting 5 FAKE_* token string literals across 'prefix' + 'suffix' in tests/test_outputs.py for GitHub secret-scanner push protection, with identical AST runtime values). (5) Diffing pinned TB2 69671fb against TB2.1 7131e43 therefore yields 30 tasks with changes outside global boilerplate/schema-format migration (26 PR #53 + 2 from 53ff2b8 + 2 from 320a8be), of which 29 are semantic changes and 1 (sanitize-git-repo) is unchanged_semantic, leaving 59 format_only tasks.
